article: What Is i18n? Internationalization and Localization Basics
scope: Compared the full Japanese article and twelve translations, acronym etymology, i18n/l10n distinction, technical terminology, locale-sensitive examples, metadata, and primary references.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates; retained 2023-04-07 and set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Corrected the conflation of character sets and character encodings; grounded Unicode and locale guidance in W3C material.
Added the distinction between internationalization and localization, message plural/order handling, regional data, and a target-locale test checklist.
Replaced Wikipedia links, including a Spanish article pointing to Japanese Wikipedia, with W3C and Unicode primary sources.
